# superset_permission_view (Resource)

Manages a permission granted on a view menu: the pair that `superset_role_permissions` gives to roles, for example `can_read` on a view menu of a custom security manager. Superset creates the pairs of its own views and of its datasets and databases itself; this resource is for the view menus of custom code. The permission must exist, since the API cannot create permissions; the view menu is created when it does not exist and deleted again with the resource, unless other permissions were granted on it meanwhile. A pair that exists already is not taken over: import it. The endpoints belong to the Flask-AppBuilder security API, which Superset only enables with `FAB_ADD_SECURITY_API = True`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A view menu of a custom security manager, readable by the Analysts role.
resource "superset_permission_view" "custom_reports_read" {
  permission_name = "can_read"
  view_menu_name  = "CustomReports"
}

resource "superset_role" "analysts" {
  name = "Analysts"
}

resource "superset_role_permissions" "analysts" {
  role_name = superset_role.analysts.name
  resource_permissions = [
    { permission = "can_read", view_menu = "CustomReports" },
  ]
  depends_on = [superset_permission_view.custom_reports_read]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission_name` (String) Name of the permission, for example `can_read` or `menu_access`. It must exist.
- `view_menu_name` (String) Name of the view menu. It is created when it does not exist.

### Read-Only

- `created_view_menu` (Boolean) Whether the resource created the view menu, in which case the destroy deletes it as well, unless other permissions are granted on it by then.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the pair.
- `permission_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the permission.
- `view_menu_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the view menu.
